national_news.title: AAI Proposes ₹1,200 Crore Terminal 3 Expansion for Bhubaneswar Airport
bullets: Airports Authority of India (AAI) submitted a proposal to the Union Finance Ministry's Public Investment Board (PIB) for Terminal 3 (T3) at Biju Patnaik International Airport (BPIA).
The proposed terminal is estimated to cost over ₹1,200 crore and will feature an annual passenger-handling capacity of 8.6 million, integrating domestic and international operations.
The expansion plan requires six additional aerobridges to complement the existing 18 aircraft aprons.

national_news.title: AAI Seeks PIB Approval for Integrated Terminal 3 at Biju Patnaik International Airport
bullets: The Airports Authority of India (AAI) has sought Public Investment Board (PIB) approval for constructing a ₹1,200 crore Terminal 3 at Bhubaneswar Airport.
The new integrated facility will merge domestic and international arrivals and departures under a single roof, accommodating up to 8.6 million passengers annually.
Six new aerobridges will be added to handle growing air traffic and streamline operations alongside existing Terminal 1 and Terminal 2 infrastructure.

national_news.title: Defence Minister Launches Rs 3,400 Crore Defence Infrastructure Projects in West Bengal
bullets: Union Defence Minister Rajnath Singh presided over the Bhumi Pujan for five projects of Garden Reach Shipbuilders and Engineers (GRSE) and Yantra India Limited (YIL) worth approximately Rs 3,400 crore in West Bengal.
The infrastructure projects, situated across Kidderpore, Shalimar, Raichak, and Ishapore, aim to enhance domestic shipbuilding capacity, quality maintenance services, and export potential.
GRSE, a Navratna Defense Public Sector Undertaking (DPSU) that has delivered over 100 vessels, is currently manufacturing a cargo ship for Germany under the Make in India initiative.

national_news.title: BRICS Sports Ministers' Meeting Concludes in Visakhapatnam with Joint Declaration
bullets: The BRICS Sports Ministers’ Meeting concluded in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh, with the consensus adoption of the BRICS Sports Joint Declaration under India's chairship.
Key outcomes include proposals to establish a BRICS Working Group on Sports Technology and conduct the inaugural BRICS Sports Manufacturing Conclave in Udaipur in November.
The BRICS Traditional and Indigenous Sports Demonstration Games are proposed to be held in Ahmedabad in October to showcase regional sporting traditions.

national_news.title: India Celebrates 3rd National Space Day Highlighting $45-Billion Space Economy Vision
bullets: India celebrated National Space Day on August 23, marking the historic anniversary of Chandrayaan-3's successful landing on the Moon's south polar region in 2023.

Addressing the 3rd National Space Day celebrations in Ahmedabad, leaders emphasized space sector reforms designed to drive India towards a $45-billion space economy and support the vision of Viksit Bharat by 2047.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi highlighted the growing role of private space startups, Gen-Z engineers, and global investment in expanding India's space ecosystem.

national_news.title: Rohit Yadav and Murali Sreeshankar Win Gold at World Athletics Continental Tour
bullets: Rohit Yadav won the javelin throw title with a personal best of 87.68 metres at the World Athletics Silver Level Continental Tour at Kalinga Stadium in Bhubaneswar.
Murali Sreeshankar clinched the men's long jump title with a leap of 8.07 metres, while Ancy Sojan led an Indian sweep in the women's long jump with a 6.71-metre effort.
Abinaya Rajarajan (19) reclaimed the Indian Under-20 national record by winning the women's 100m event in 11.34 seconds.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Restructures Loan Mechanism for Bihar Student Credit Card Scheme
bullets: The Bihar government reiterated that financial assistance of up to ₹4 lakh under the Bihar Student Credit Card Scheme remains intact for higher education.
Education loans up to ₹2 lakh will now be provided via the Bihar State Education Finance Corporation, while loans between ₹2 lakh and ₹4 lakh will be disbursed through scheduled commercial banks.

The state approved an expenditure of ₹950 crore for the scheme in FY 2026-27 (up from ₹886 crore in 2025-26) and integrated it with the PM VidyaLakshmi Portal and PM Uchchatar Shiksha Protsahan Yojana.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Plans ₹70,000 Crore Expansion of JP Ganga Path to Koilwar
bullets: The Bihar government proposed extending the existing 21-km JP Ganga Path into a 126-km Ganga riverfront corridor reaching Koilwar on the Sone River.
The project involves an estimated outlay of ₹70,000 crore, comprising ₹20,000 crore state budgetary support and ₹50,000 crore from private investments.
The corridor aims to modernize state urban infrastructure, enhance regional connectivity, and boost economic activities along the riverfront.

bihar_news.title: Bihar CM Announces 'Mati Kala Board' for Artisans' Welfare
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary announced the establishment of a 'Mati Kala Board' (Terracotta Art Board) within three months to preserve traditional clay art and promote the Kumhar (Prajapati) community.
The Board will systematically focus on providing modern technology, skill development training, and improved market access to traditional clay artisans.
The announcement was made at Shri Krishna Memorial Hall in Patna during a memorial program honoring 13-year-old freedom struggle martyr Ramchandra Vidyarthi.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Sets Up 5-Member Panel for Examination Framework Reforms
bullets: The General Administration Department of Bihar constituted a five-member expert committee to recommend comprehensive reforms in the state's examination system.
The panel's mandate covers reviewing end-to-end examination procedures across state commissions, recruitment agencies, and universities—from registration to result declaration.
A primary objective is to implement stringent protocols to prevent paper leaks, impersonation, cheating, and data tampering.

bihar_news.title: Parliamentary Panel Reviews Transport, Tourism, and Heritage Infrastructure in Bihar
bullets: The Parliamentary Standing Committee on Transport, Tourism and Culture, chaired by Sanjay Jha, conducted a three-day review of central infrastructure and tourism projects in Bihar.
Key infrastructure projects reviewed include the proposed greenfield international airport and major highway corridors like Patna-Purnia, Gorakhpur-Siliguri, and NH-27.
The panel inspected cultural and heritage sites including the Bihar Museum, Khuda Bakhsh Library, Kumrahar ASI site, Rajgir, and Bodh Gaya to prepare recommendations for Parliament.

bihar_news.title: Bihar CM Unveils Industrial and Governance Targets at ET World Leaders Forum
bullets: Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary launched the 'Build Bihar, Believe in Bihar' campaign at the ET World Leaders Forum to accelerate economic transformation over four years.
Highlighted the 'Sahyog Grievance Redressal Program', which mandates a 30-day resolution deadline for public complaints and has resolved 96% of 6.42 lakh applications to date.
Announced sector-specific policies for Semiconductors and Global Capability Centres (GCC), alongside showcasing an expansion of total irrigated area from 2.1 million to 4.4 million hectares.
